message:
8 MB uploads now work. The config had `uploads.maxMb` set to 5, and I changed it to 10 in `config/default.json` to match `docs/product.md`.

`npm test` passes, including the uploads tests. The API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is computed from the same setting, so it now allows 11 MB.
